items.text: The renewal notice for our FleetTrack Pro subscription is attached. Please disregard the earlier invoice dated March 3; the correct amount is $4,280 for the annual term.

During the Q2 performance review cycle, managers should follow the calibration guidelines distributed last week. Note that any ratings above 'exceeds expectations' require additional justification and a second reviewer's sign-off. The HR team will host two optional workshops on writing constructive feedback; dates are in the shared calendar. Employees are encouraged to complete their self-assessments by May 15. If you have questions about the process, reach out to your HR business partner. Remember that all review discussions are confidential and should not be shared outside the company.

The new onboarding checklist for engineering hires is now live in Notion. It covers laptop setup, access requests, and a series of introductory meetings with team leads. Please ensure new hires complete the security training module within their first week. The checklist also includes a section for feedback from the onboarding buddy. Any urgent issues during onboarding should be escalated to the IT helpdesk. We've added a chatbot named 'OnboardBot' to answer common questions, but it's not a replacement for human guidance.

The vendor has sent a reminder that our data analytics platform subscription auto-renews on June 1. The current plan includes 50 user seats and premium support. If we wish to change the number of seats or downgrade, we must notify them by May 20. Please review the attached usage report to see if we're utilizing all seats. Disregard the previous renewal quote; this one reflects the negotiated 5% discount. Contact procurement if you have questions.

In the performance review meeting, we discussed the importance of timely feedback. The new automated tool will help managers track review deadlines and send reminders. It does not replace the need for face-to-face conversations. Please ensure all reviews are submitted by the end of the month. Confidential comments should be marked appropriately. If you encounter any issues with the tool, contact HR.
The onboarding checklist includes a step to set up your profile in the HR portal. Please disregard the outdated link in the previous version; the correct URL is in the shared drive.

The subscription renewal for our project management software is coming up. The current contract expires on July 31, and the vendor has offered a 10% discount if we renew before June 15. We need to decide whether to continue with the same number of licenses or adjust based on current team size. The finance team will review the budget impact next week.

A new AI assistant feature is included in the renewal, which can help automate task assignments. However, some team members have expressed concerns about data privacy. We will schedule a demo with the vendor to address these questions. Please send any specific concerns to the admin team by Friday.

Disregard the previous email about renewal pricing; the vendor corrected the quote. All updates will be posted in the shared folder.

Performance reviews this year will incorporate peer feedback collected via an automated survey tool. Managers should remind their teams to complete the surveys by April 10. The tool sends reminders automatically, but please follow up personally if someone hasn't responded. Confidentiality is maintained; only aggregated results are shared. If you have technical issues, contact the survey administrator.

The onboarding checklist for remote employees includes shipping equipment and scheduling virtual introductions. Please ensure new hires receive their laptops before their start date. The IT team uses an automated ticketing system for equipment requests. Urgent issues should be flagged in the ticket. A chatbot is available for common questions about benefits enrollment.

In our recent performance review calibration session, we noted that some managers were not consistently applying the rating scale. To address this, we will provide additional training and a revised rubric. The new rubric includes clearer examples for each rating level. Managers should use the rubric for all upcoming reviews. We also discussed the use of an AI assistant to help draft review comments, but decided against it for this cycle due to confidentiality concerns.

Disregard the old rubric; the new one will be available on the HR portal by next Monday. Please review it before starting your reviews. If you have questions, contact the HR team. The deadline for submitting reviews remains May 30.
